correctness.rationale: For odd P and a coprime odd prime r, the exact count by r consecutive P-blocks gives T(Pr)=(r-1)S(P)/2+T(P)-2B_P(r), while S(Pr)=(r-2)S(P); therefore D(Pr)=(S(P)+1)/2+T(P)-2B_P(r). Direct integer enumeration confirms S(65)=33,T(65)=15,B_65(24)=19 and S(119)=75,T(119)=38,B_119(31)=35, yielding -6 and +6. Exhaustive enumeration of all 48 and 96 reduced residues yields distributions (-6:1,-4:5,-2:18,0:18,2:5,4:1) and (-4:1,-2:10,0:37,2:37,4:10,6:1). Exhaustive semiprime supports below 65 or 119 establish sign-specific minima (not minima of the full three-prime integers). Dirichlet provides infinitely many primes in both classes, and fixed-modulus prime-number theorem yields densities. Finite counts alone do not prove infinitude.
